programs.title: What We Do
programs.intro: We create spaces where girls can bloom and glow through honest conversations, meaningful connections, learning, laughter, and girl-led experiences.

programList.name: Weekly Vibes
programList.description: Small moments throughout the week that help Bloomies connect, check in, stay encouraged, and have fun.

activities.name: Motivation Monday
activities.focus: Encouragement, goals, mindset, and starting the week with intention.

activities.name: Wellness Wednesday
activities.focus: Check-ins, emotional wellness, self-care, and honest conversations.

activities.name: Fun Friday
activities.focus: Games, laughter, connection, and lighter moments with the Bloomies.

activities.name: Reflection Saturday
activities.focus: Looking back on the week, sharing lessons, and checking in with yourself.

programList.name: Community Conversations
programList.description: Honest conversations about the things girls are experiencing, wondering about, learning, and figuring out.

features.title: Honest Conversations
features.description: A space to talk about real-life experiences without needing everything to sound perfect.

features.title: Girl-Led Topics
features.description: Conversations can grow from the questions, interests, and experiences of the girls themselves.

features.title: Conversations That Stay With You
features.description: We want conversations to leave girls with something useful to think about, explore, or carry forward.

programList.name: Guest Speaker Program
programList.description: Monthly online conversations with people who bring experiences, knowledge, stories, and perspectives that can help Bloomies learn and grow.
programList.topicSelection: Topics are shaped by the girls and the conversations they want to have.

programList.name: Quarterly Calls
programList.description: Online community calls that give Bloomies a chance to actually see and connect with one another beyond everyday group conversations.

programList.name: Game Nights
programList.description: Because girls need fun too! Game nights create room for laughter, friendly competition, random conversations, and memories with the Bloomies.

programList.name: Anonymous Night
programList.description: A space where Bloomies can submit anonymous thoughts, questions, experiences, or things they may not feel comfortable saying openly.
purpose: Help girls realise they are not alone
programList.safetyNote: Anonymous participation does not remove the need for respect. Community conversations should remain kind, responsible, and safe.

programList.name: Special Initiatives
programList.description: Occasional projects, campaigns, challenges, and activities created around a specific need, idea, opportunity, or community moment.

howProgramsWork.title: Listen
howProgramsWork.description: We pay attention to what girls are saying, asking, experiencing, and looking for.

howProgramsWork.title: Ask
howProgramsWork.description: We make room for questions and conversations rather than assuming we already know what girls need.

howProgramsWork.title: Create
howProgramsWork.description: We turn ideas into conversations, activities, programs, and experiences that girls can actually participate in.

howProgramsWork.title: Grow
howProgramsWork.description: We learn from each experience and keep improving the Circle as the community grows.

biggerPicture.title: A girl feels less alone.
biggerPicture.description: She knows there are other girls who understand, listen, and care.

biggerPicture.title: A girl finds her voice.
biggerPicture.description: She gets room to ask questions, share her thoughts, and express herself.

biggerPicture.title: A girl finds her people.
biggerPicture.description: She builds connections and friendships that make the community feel like somewhere she belongs.

futurePrograms.description: As the community grows, Girls' Unplugged can expand its programs based on what Bloomies need and what the community is ready to build.
